headword: {自覚症状|じかくしょうじょう}
gloss: subjective symptoms; symptoms the patient can feel

definitions.gloss: subjective symptoms; symptoms the patient can feel
definitions.explanation: Symptoms of an illness or condition that the patient personally notices, such as pain, fatigue, or dizziness — as opposed to signs that can only be detected by a doctor or test.

examples.japanese: {自覚症状|じかくしょうじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧{自覚症状|じかくしょうじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自覚症状|じかくしょうじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧な⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Because there are almost no noticeable symptoms in the early stages, regular checkups are important.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自覚|じかく}→自覚：05319_jikaku⟧ (self-awareness, consciousness of) and ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧ (symptom). {自覚症状|じかくしょうじょう} refers specifically to symptoms that the patient can feel or notice themselves, such as headache, nausea, or numbness. The phrase {自覚症状|じかくしょうじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ ("no noticeable symptoms") is especially common in discussions of conditions that develop silently, such as high blood pressure or early-stage cancers.
